title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Billing Rights Summary: Dispute Timeframes by Card
content:
The timeframes that govern a billing-error notice on Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards, by card. Each column is the Marlowe & Finch card of that name.

| | Store Card | Store Card Plus | Store Card Elite | Mastercard | Platinum Mastercard | World Elite Mastercard |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Notice window after the first statement showing the charge (calendar days) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Written acknowledgement within (calendar days after the notice) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Resolution within (complete billing cycles after the notice) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Resolution never later than (calendar days after the notice) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Temporary credit posts within (business days after the notice) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 5 |

## What each timeframe measures

- **Notice window** — the calendar days after the statement date of the first statement on which a charge appeared within which a billing-error notice must be received.
- **Acknowledgement** — the calendar days after the notice is received within which the dispute is acknowledged in writing.
- **Resolution in billing cycles** — the maximum number of complete billing cycles after the notice within which the dispute is resolved.
- **Resolution in days** — the absolute maximum calendar days after the notice within which the dispute is resolved.
- **Temporary credit** — the business days after the notice within which a temporary (provisional) credit for the disputed amount posts on unauthorized-charge and duplicate-charge disputes.

## Example (hypothetical notice)

A Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard cardmember's duplicate-charge notice received on a Monday carries a temporary credit within 5 business days; the same notice on a Marlowe & Finch Store Card carries it within 10 business days. On either card the dispute is acknowledged within 30 calendar days and resolved within 2 complete billing cycles, and never later than 90 calendar days after the notice.
